tasks.description: Zero-resource backup-path repair handoff after the receipt-key repair passed. The prior task proved that external backup recoverability remains blocked while consuming zero solver/plant/training/validation/test resources. This task reads only existing backup-gate artifacts and the protected backup service source as text (without importing it and without reading credentials), records the release-cap/TimeoutError/HTTP-422 evidence, writes a supervisor-compatible backup release-rotation or equivalent repair request, and preserves the nonzero-work gate. It does not run backup upload, controllers, solvers, plant, training/refit, validation episodes, sealed tests, or final tests.
